args_named.title: Method Study 001: phantom liquidity in GB BM data (retrospective, corpus 2026-08-04..10)

args_named.statement: In the 2026-08-04..2026-08-10 corpus, more than half of raw pairwise price-order inversions involve an unaccepted alternative that is clearly non-deliverable under the conservative public physical-state bound declared in METHOD-STUDY-001.md.

args_named.conclusion: CONFIRMED: 67.3 percent of the 3,856,031 raw pairwise price-order inversions in the 2026-08-04..10 corpus (2,595,381) involve an alternative provably non-deliverable under the pre-declared conservative public physical-state bound; these collapse to 76,289 of 158,953 unique alternatives (48.0 percent). The residual (1,260,650 pairwise; 82,664 unique) SURVIVES the checks applied and is not thereby evidence of dispatch error.
